title: ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru, Affiliated to VTU is also offering Four Years B.Sc Honors Program from the academic year 2022-23
content:
Features of the Program
  • 4 Years B.Sc Honors Course, Total 8 Semesters
  • Major Disciplines
  • Physics Major
  • Chemistry Major
  • Mathematics Major
  • Common Syllabus in First 3 Semesters
  • Major subjects will be studied in depth from the fourth semester along with other stream electives
  • Total Number of Seats: 60
  • Type 1: Karnataka Students: Merit-Based: 30 Seats
  • Type 2: Karnataka/Non-Karnataka/ Foreign : 30 Seats
  Highlights of the Program
  • Provision to acquire a Major degree in a discipline,  Minor degree in other disciplines and Dual degree in two disciplines.
  • In addition to core science courses, there are ability enhancement courses as per NEP
  • After completing 4 years B.Sc. Honors with suitable grades and research component, students are eligible for 2 semesters Master’s degree or Doctoral Program in the relevant discipline.
  • As ATME Engineering College is affiliated to Technological University- Better Placement Opportunities
